programme.desc: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Rica’s mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons S1E1 -Spring / 美國在野四季錄 第1集 - 春
programme.desc: It’s spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E3 -Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist / 野生動物急診室 第3集 - 諱疾忌牙醫
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E3 -Thailand: Coming of Age / 野性湄公河 第3集 - 泰國：發展壯大
programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong’s banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region’s abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E2 -Magicians of the Reef / 阿拉伯海 第2集 - 礁石魔術師
programme.desc: Arabia’s coral reefs are home to some of nature’s most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E3 -Island Feast / 阿拉伯海 第3集 - 島嶼饗宴
programme.desc: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can’t resist.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E4 -Mountains / 仙境森林的秘密 第4集 - 深山探秘
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Animal Senses S1E6 -Humans vs Animals / 動物感官世界 第6集 - 人與獸的對決
programme.desc: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E5 -Turtle Trouble / 野生動物急診室 第5集 - 烏龜的麻煩
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E5 -Nature's Crossroads / 野性湄公河 第5集 - 大自然的十字路口
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailand’s eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E3 -One Very Lost Sea Turtle / 捍衞太平洋 第3集 - 迷途龜洋
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E1 -The Rescuers / 狗建奇工 第1集 - 拯救者們
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1E3 -The Next Generation / 深淵異形 第3集 - 下世代
programme.desc: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the ocean’s most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E3 -Children of the Storm / 風暴之子 第3集 - 冰雪之子

programme.title: Supersenses S1E3 -Invisible World / 動物超感官 第一季 第3集 - 隱形世界
programme.desc: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we can’t see, sound we can’t hear and even stranger forces we can’t begin to detect.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E1 -Baby Sea Otter Finds a Family / 捍衞太平洋 第1集 - 小海獺求包養
programme.desc: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E2 -Battle to Save a Sea Lion / 捍衞太平洋 第2集 - 拯救「獅」
programme.desc: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E3 -Water Worlds / 仙境森林的秘密 第3集 - 水世界
programme.desc: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E1 -Out of the Darkness / 風暴之子 第1集 - 走出黑暗
programme.desc: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E2 -Return of the Light / 風暴之子 第2集 - 回歸光明
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Animal Senses S1E1 -Smell / 動物感官世界 第1集 - 嗅覺
programme.desc: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animal’s environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

programme.title: Ocean Parks S1E5 -Bahamas Exuma Cays / 海洋公園 第5集 - 巴哈馬埃克蘇馬礁
programme.desc: The Exuma Cays are a remote wonder: hundreds of tiny islands extending south from the Bahamian Capital of Nassau. In the 1950’s, developers dreamed of developing this pristine, and largely unexplored region. But before construction could begin, the Bahamian government supported an expedition to chart the cays. They liked what they saw, and in 1959 established the Bahamas National Trust, creating the Bahamas’ first Ocean Park.

programme.title: Land of Gremlins S1E3 -Madagascar in Cold Blood / 精靈之國 第3集 - 馬達加斯加的冷血動物
programme.desc: Explore the lives of Madagascar’s cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E1 -Frida the Jaguar Cub / 野小子 第1集 - 美洲虎幼崽弗里達
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who’s honing her survival skills in Brazil’s Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E2 -Lola the Sea Lion Pup / 野小子 第2集 - 海獅幼崽蘿拉
programme.desc: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentina’s coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Maria’s side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E3 -Dora the Baby Muriqui / 野小子 第3集 - 絨毛蛛猴寶寶朵拉
programme.desc: Feel the enchantment of Brazil’s Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E4 -Thiago the Coati Kitten / 野小子 第4集 - 長鼻浣熊小貓蒂亞戈
programme.desc: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E5 -Rio the Giant River Otter Pup / 野小子 第5集 - 巨型水獺幼崽里奧
programme.desc: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazil’s beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island S1E5 -The Berenty Dynasty / 大戰狐島 第5集 - 貝亨提王朝
programme.desc: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S3E1 -Wild Coast of South Africa / 野性汪洋 第1集 - 南非狂野海岸
programme.desc: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduct her first-ever manta ray expedition within South Africa’s borders...

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S3E2 -Save the Giants / 野性汪洋 第2集 - 拯救巨人
programme.desc: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the world’s largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defenceless against reckless overfishing. Two of Mozambique’s leading marine researchers, Andrea Marshall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the ocean’s most secretive animals and protect its most well known, before its too late.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S3E3 -Macro Mozambique / 野性汪洋 第3集 - 莫桑比克宏觀
programme.desc: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S3E4 -Life in the Food Chain / 野性汪洋 第4集 - 食物鏈
programme.desc: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the world’s largest food web – plankton. These microscopic organisms drift through the ocean’s diverse habitats, triggering feeding cycles in their wake. Without them, life in the ocean would cease to exist.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E1 -Australia / 狂野天空 第1集 - 澳洲篇
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the world’s most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E2 -North America / 狂野天空 第2集 - 北美洲篇
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E3 -Africa / 狂野天空 第3集 - 非洲
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africa’s wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1E1 -Origin Stories / 深淵異形 第1集 - 起源故事
programme.desc: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years’ worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1E2 -Allies and Adversaries / 深淵異形 第2集 - 敵友能分
programme.desc: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earth’s oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

programme.title: Animal Senses S1E2 -Touch / 動物感官世界 第2集 - 觸覺
programme.desc: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E1 -The Drakensberg: Barrier of Spears / 非洲隱世國度 第1集 - 龍山：矛之屏障
programme.desc: This documentary looks at the wildlife of The Drakensberg Mountain range. We take a look at how creatures survive in the hostile landscape, from the highest peaks to the rolling grasslands below.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E1 -Queen of Yala / 風之島 第1集 - 亞拉之后
programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It’s time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E2 -Loka the Baby Elephant / 風之島 第2集 - 小象洛卡
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E3 -Lake Hunters / 風之島 第3集 - 湖中獵者
programme.desc: Sri Lanka’s lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but don’t be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E4 -Web of Life / 風之島 第4集 - 生命的網絡
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E5 -From Cloud to Coast / 風之島 第5集 - 雲霧至海濱
programme.desc: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island’s forests.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon S1E6 -Life on the Wing / 風之島 第6集 - 雀鳥日常
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

programme.title: Cub Camp S1E5 -A Bear’s Thanksgiving / 熊寶貝訓練營 第5集 - 小熊感恩祭
programme.desc: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Cub Camp S1E6 -Goodbye Campers / 熊寶貝訓練營 第6集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Prepare for the summer cubs’ release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

programme.title: Supersenses S1E1 -Super Sight / 動物超感官 第一季 第1集 - 超視力
programme.desc: Vision – it’s how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

programme.title: Supersenses S1E2 -Super Powers / 動物超感官 第一季 第2集 - 超能力
programme.desc: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

programme.title: Supersenses S1E3 -Invisible World / 動物超感官 第一季 第3集 - 隱形世界
programme.desc: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we can’t see, sound we can’t hear and even stranger forces we can’t begin to detect.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands S1E1 -The Wilds of Winter / 愛爾蘭：野性島嶼 第1集 - 狂野冬日
programme.desc: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands S1E2 -Summer on the Edge / 愛爾蘭：野性島嶼 第2集 - 盛夏光景
programme.desc: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdom S1E1 -Water Worlds / 歐洲野王國 第1集 - 水之世界
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdom S1E2 -Mountain Worlds / 歐洲野王國 第2集 - 山之世界
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E4 -Mountains / 仙境森林的秘密 第4集 - 深山探秘
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E5 -Boreal / 仙境森林的秘密 第5集 - 北方
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E6 -Extreme / 仙境森林的秘密 第6集 - 極致秘密
programme.desc: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

programme.desc: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E1 -Kimba's Rise / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 金巴得勢
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride’s nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E2 -Prides and Prejudice / 非洲獵人 第2集 - 族群與偏見
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he’s saved from snapping jaws and cements the family’s future.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E1 -A Summer to Remember / 野生動物急診室 第1集 - 難忘的夏季
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E1 -The Journey Begins / 野性湄公河 第1集 - 旅程的開始
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China’s land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E3 -Children of the Storm / 風暴之子 第3集 - 冰雪之子
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful / 怪．野．美
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdom S1E1 -Water Worlds / 歐洲野王國 第1集 - 水之世界
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E1 -Kimba's Rise / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 金巴得勢
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride’s nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E2 -Prides and Prejudice / 非洲獵人 第2集 - 族群與偏見
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he’s saved from snapping jaws and cements the family’s future.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E2 -Magicians of the Reef / 阿拉伯海 第2集 - 礁石魔術師
programme.desc: Arabia’s coral reefs are home to some of nature’s most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E3 -Island Feast / 阿拉伯海 第3集 - 島嶼饗宴
programme.desc: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can’t resist.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E2 -A Prickly Problem / 野生動物急診室 第2集 - 一個棘手難題
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala’s spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle’s slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E2 -Laos: the Mountain Wilds / 野性湄公河 第2集 - 老撾：山地荒野
programme.desc: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

programme.desc: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years’ worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S3E3 -Costa Rica: Sky to Sea / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 哥斯達黎加：海天之間

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons S1E1 -Spring / 美國在野四季錄 第1集 - 春
programme.desc: It’s spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Animal Senses S1E6 -Humans vs Animals / 動物感官世界 第6集 - 人與獸的對決
programme.desc: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S3E3 -Costa Rica: Sky to Sea / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 哥斯達黎加：海天之間
programme.desc: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Rica’s mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons S1E1 -Spring / 美國在野四季錄 第1集 - 春
programme.desc: It’s spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1E2 -Allies and Adversaries / 深淵異形 第2集 - 敵友能分
programme.desc: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earth’s oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E3 -One Very Lost Sea Turtle / 捍衞太平洋 第3集 - 迷途龜洋
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E1 -The Rescuers / 狗建奇工 第1集 - 拯救者們
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E4 -Platypus Predicament / 野生動物急診室 第4集 - 鴨嘴獸的困境
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E4 -The Karst Caves / 野性湄公河 第4集 - 寮國：喀斯特地形
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob S1E1 / Kangaroo Mob 第1集
programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”. Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E3 -Kamilaroi Highway (Part 2) / Great Aussie Road Trips 第3集 - Kamilaroi Highway (Part 2)
programme.desc: Part Two of our Kamilaroi Highway road-trip starts in Lightning Ridge and wraps up in Bourke, and we’re blessed with more sensational countryside, and the awesome stories that make this area of Australia so popular. This is a part of Australia everyone needs to discover.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E4 -Sturts Steps / Great Aussie Road Trips 第4集 - Sturts Steps
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken by European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in the very interior of the country.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E5 -Hadrian’s Wall - Chesters Roman Fort and Carlisle / River Hunters 第5集 - Hadrian’s Wall - Chesters Roman Fort and Carlisle
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette are heading to Britain’s most spectacular and best-preserved Roman frontier - Hadrian’s wall. They will scour the two rivers that flow along its path looking for lost evidence from the might of 2nd century Rome and the invaders’ brutal occupation of Britain.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E1 -Central Australia / Experience Australia 第1集 - Central Australia
programme.desc: In this first episode, we showcase the best experiences on offer in Central Australia, also known as ‘The Red Centre.’ This ancient land is brimming with natural wonders and cultural significance. programme.title: Experience Australia S1E2 -Sydney and its Surrounding Areas / Experience Australia 第2集 - Sydney and its Surrounding Areas

Get ready to Experience Australia.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here S2E5 -Port-au-Prince / Don't Drive Here 第5集 - Port-au-Prince

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E1 -Scoters and the Salton Sea / Dead Meat 第1集 - Scoters and the Salton Sea
programme.desc: Scott hits the waters of California in search of the ducks...and duck waters less hunted. Join the surf scoter hunt on the San Francisco Bay, then head south to an area Scott Leysath refers to as ''The Hills Have Eyes.'' The Salton Sea, just a couple hours east of Los Angeles, has a creep factor of 11, and the duck hunting is like no other place he has hunted.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E2 -Rivers of Recovery / Dead Meat 第2集 - Rivers of Recovery
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by wounded combat vets and a great group of supporters for a Rivers of Recovery fundraiser. They bowfish at night for invasive snakeheads, carp and whatever else swims within bow range.

programme.title: Danger Decoded S1E4 -Roads / Danger Decoded 第4集 - Roads
programme.desc: Explore the world’s most treacherous paths from icy Alaskan highways to perilous mountain passes.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E5 -More Texas Swine / Dead Meat 第5集 - More Texas Swine
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E6 -What's a Nilgai? / Dead Meat 第6集 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E7 -What's That Smell? / Dead Meat 第7集 - What's That Smell?
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E8 -It's Not All Good / Dead Meat 第8集 - It's Not All Good
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E1 -South Australia / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第1集 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E2 -Northern Territory / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第2集 - Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E1 -Habitat Conservation / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1集 - Habitat Conservation
programme.desc: From Sydney to the Greater Blue Mountains, Zac and Darin meet with leading eco-warriors to learn about protected lands and habitat conservation.

programme.desc: Zac and Darin get down and dirty as they explore a natural approach to farming through regenerative agriculture and organic food production.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E6 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege / River Hunters 第6集 - Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.desc: Sara goes to Yawuru conservation park to try and catch some mud crabs with cultural guide Bart, who is originally from Broome.

programme.title: Ultimate Freedive S1E1 -The Great Barrier Reef / Ultimate Freedive 第1集 - The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc:
World champion freediver Marina Kazankova is on a mission, to free dive the Great Barrier Reef.
Capable of holding her breath for 7-minutes at a time, Marina travels to the iconic reef, swimming with turtles and giant groper, diving on ship wrecks and through awesome caves, all on a single breath of air.
Capturing each challenge in glorious 4K, this series brings you face to face with the very best of the Great Barrier Reef’s corals and creatures.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E1 -Polar Bear / Extreme Animal Transport 第1集 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket close to the

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E2 -Tigers (Circus Tigers) / Extreme Animal Transport 第2集 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E5 -More Texas Swine / Dead Meat 第5集 - More Texas Swine
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E6 -What's a Nilgai? / Dead Meat 第6集 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E5 -More Texas Swine / Dead Meat 第5集 - More Texas Swine
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E6 -What's a Nilgai? / Dead Meat 第6集 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer S1E1 / The Whale Whisperer 第1集

With Bear's help, Zac challenges himself physically, as well as mentally, on an awe-inspiring journey he could never have imagined.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E7 -What's That Smell? / Dead Meat 第7集 - What's That Smell?
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E8 -It's Not All Good / Dead Meat 第8集 - It's Not All Good
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E3 -Great Berrier Reef / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第3集 - Great Berrier Reef
programme.desc: Along the coastline, Zac and Darin take a deep dive into the coral reef restoration techniques supporting a vast underwater ecosystem.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E4 -Torres Strait / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第4集 - Torres Strait
programme.desc: Zac and Darin test their cooking skills in Melbourne before heading to the Torres Strait Islands to understand the impact of rising sea levels.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled S1E5 -Western Australia: Driving in the Dusty Kimberly / Sara's Australia Unveiled 第5集 - Western Australia: Driving in the Dusty Kimberly
programme.desc: Sara drives to East Kimberley, soaking in the scenery of the Cockburn Range mountains. Sara is so inspired by the communal spirit at Home Valley Station that she contributes by hosting a pizza night - with a wood fire oven crocodile pizza.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled S1E6 -Western Australia: More Than Meets The Eye / Sara's Australia Unveiled 第6集 - Western Australia: More Than Meets The Eye
programme.desc: Sara goes to Yawuru conservation park to try and catch some mud crabs with cultural guide Bart, who is originally from Broome.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E1 -Polar Bear / Extreme Animal Transport 第1集 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E2 -Tigers (Circus Tigers) / Extreme Animal Transport 第2集 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E4 -Sturts Steps / Great Aussie Road Trips 第4集 - Sturts Steps
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken by European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in the very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E5 -Central Victoria / Great Aussie Road Trips 第5集 - Central Victoria
programme.desc: Central Victoria is ‘river & ranges country’, and is an easy drive out of Victoria’s capital, Melbourne. Epic scenery, outstanding natural beauty, lots of history, and down to earth hospitality, our road-trip through Central Victoria does not disappoint.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E6 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege / River Hunters 第6集 - Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid S2E18 -Lost Sites / 丹尼斯·奎德的神聖奇觀 第18集 - 失落聖地
programme.desc: Archaeologists have spent centuries searching for the locations of holy births, deaths, miracles, and wars. In this episode, we explore the stories behind these lost sites and the endeavours to find them.

programme.title: The Mega-Brands That Built The World S2E5 -Internet Killed The Video Store / 建構世界的大廠牌 第5集 - 串流崛起
programme.desc: A software engineer is inspired to create a bigger, unprecedented family-friendly video store, Blockbuster. But as the dot-com boom explodes, an opening appears for two executives to redefine the industry.

programme.title: American Godfathers: The Five Families E3 -The Last Don / 美國教父: 五大家族 第3集 - 最後的教父
programme.desc: The Last Don shows how a decidedly new, more aggressive commitment by law enforcement to 'eradicate' the mafia forces the families to find creative ways to stay in business and out of jail.

programme.title: The Food That Built The World S4E43 -Dog Eat Dog / 建構世界的食品 第43集 - 狗咬狗狗
programme.desc: At a time when dog food is a rarity and cat food is almost nonexistent, it will take visionary innovators to invent the first dog treat, the first cat food, and many more innovations.

programme.desc: A quick stop for gas turns into a parent's worst nightmare when a 6 year old boy is snatched during a carjacking. Tess and Jake race against the clock to bring the child home alive as Sunny pours all her focus away from her trauma and into the case. When Tess and Jake track down the perp in a tense OJ style pursuit, Tess's empathy defuses a potentially deadly standoff, reuniting the boy safely with his family and prompting her to reflect on her own family history. programme.desc: Creators go head-to-head in Sarawak, pushing through high-energy challenges and uncovering local culture, people, and hidden gems as they go.

programme.title: Sight Unseen S2E3 -Chain Reaction / 看不見的罪案 第3集 - Chain Reaction
programme.desc: During a routine interview at a chemical plant, Tess and Leo are trapped by a gunman looking to kill the plant's manager. Tess and Leo's attempt to evacuate the target and other workers safely is cut short when Leo is shot and injured, leaving Tess and Sunny to outsmart the gunman, escape the lockdown, and save the day. With unexpected help from Matt and Mia, Sunny guides Tess around the highly flammable plant to save Leo's life and uncover the gunman's motive before he blows them all up. Tess and Sunny are both blindsided by unsettling news as Lucas shares plans to get married, and Sunny finally uncovers Rigby's secret.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine:2023-2024 E17 -Pays De Vesoul / Epicerie Fine 第17集 - Pays De Vesoul
programme.desc: Valentin Fleytoux and Rodolphe Dieudonne produce farmhouse 'cancoillotte'; Camille Ponnelle and Xavier Mariot are farmers producing oils. Restoration of the River La Linotte with Guillaume Blondel-Gaborieau, engineer and mayor of Loulans-Verchamp. Foraging in the wild and the reintroduction of local varieties with Adrien Leturgie, of the association FNE 70.

programme.desc: Cauliflower season is almost over! Isabelle offers cauliflower as a spicy 'steak' with tahini ranch sauce and in a white bean dip with roasted garlic.

programme.title: La Cuisine D'isabelle ET Ricardo S1E8 -Macaroni With Squash And Beetroot Salad / La Cuisine D'isabelle ET Ricardo 第8集 - Macaroni With Squash And Beetroot Salad
programme.desc: Two recipes that prove vegetables can be as generous as they are colourful! Isabelle prepares macaroni cheese with squash, plus a rocket salad with trout and yellow beetroot.

programme.title: Generation F S1E18 -Jerome Valton (Paris)/Rylsee (Berlin) / Generation F 第18集 - Jerome Valton (Paris)/Rylsee (Berlin)
programme.desc: In Paris, Richard Orlinski meets Jerome Valton, a visual artist and screen printer who draws inspiration from pedological patterns and cartography. A Swiss artist based in Berlin since 2012, Rylsee is influenced by hip-hop culture and urban art. He has established himself with a black-and-white graphic style, combining letters and shapes.

programme.title: Le Gout Des Rencontres En Nouvelle-Aquitaine:2024 E77 -Cordon Bleu And Polenta Fries In Poitiers / Le Gout Des Rencontres En Nouvelle-Aquitaine 第77集 - Cordon Bleu And Polenta Fries In Poitiers
programme.desc: At Poitiers University Hospital, Alessandra Montagne meets Anne-Sophie, a nurse. Together, they organize a cooking workshop. On the day's menu: cordon bleu and polenta fries.

programme.title: Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature:2021-2022 E6 -The Esterel, From The Sea Side / Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature 第6集 - The Esterel, From The Sea Side
programme.desc: The rugged terrain, jagged landscapes and steep coves of the Esterel massif plunge into the Mediterranean Sea. Witnesses to an eventful geological history, they offer surprising and contrasting scenery for divers, fishermen and other lovers of the coastline.

programme.title: Meteo A La Carte:2025-2026 E216 / Meteo A La Carte 第216集
programme.desc: An interactive programme that's as fun as it is informative and reactive to the meteorological events of the moment. programme.title: Epicerie Fine:2023-2024 E19 -Charente-Maritime Special Programme / Epicerie Fine 第19集 - Charente-Maritime Special Programme
programme.desc: Sebastien Lys uses eye and ear to fish for mullet; Brice Thomas shares his passion for producing salt. Collecting ray eggs with the association IODDE. Raphael Musseau, doctor in ecology, and Jean-Claude Barbraud, ornithologist at the Museum National d'Histoire Naturelle, follow white storks. Plus a visit to Marans.

programme.title: Tendance XXI Express S10E25 / Tendance XXI Express 第25集
programme.desc: Fashion, craftwork, design, beauty, cuisine, lifestyle... a round-up of the best moments from 'Tendance XXI'!

programme.title: La Cuisine D'isabelle ET Ricardo S1E7 -Cauliflower / La Cuisine D'isabelle ET Ricardo 第7集 - Cauliflower

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs:2026 E1 -La Hulpe / Les Ambassadeurs 第1集 - La Hulpe
programme.desc: Just a stone's throw from Brussels, La Hulpe, a green gem of Walloon Brabant, charms visitors with its rolling landscapes, its castle and its dense forests. In this bucolic municipality, the preservation of fauna and flora is at the heart of local concerns.

programme.title: L'epicerie:2026 E5 -Manitoba, The New Leader In School Nutrition / L'epicerie 第5集 - Manitoba, The New Leader In School Nutrition
programme.desc: In 2024, Ottawa committed $1 billion to help provinces and territories implement a national school food program; yellow peas, the protein of the moment; and the culinary specialties of the Metis Nation.

programme.title: Escapades En Suisse Italienne S2E14 -Val Bregaglia / Escapades En Suisse Italienne 第14集 - Val Bregaglia
programme.desc: After visiting the village of Soglio and its historic buildings, we set off on the La Plotta trail, between nature, art and craftsmanship. In Coltura, we discover pottery making and an enigmatic glacial erratic.

programme.title: Meteo A La Carte:2025-2026 E216 / Meteo A La Carte 第216集

programme.title: Epicerie Fine:2023-2024 E16 -Bugey And The Ain Valley / Epicerie Fine 第16集 - Bugey And The Ain Valley
programme.desc: We meet winegrower Pierre Dubreuil and aromatic plant grower Veronique Briday. We also discover all about underground microfauna with cavers Josiane and Bernard Lips, and educational activities for schools with Marion Crampette, from the Rivieres Sauvages network association.

programme.title: Vf S9E52 -Redfield & Dattner, Wall Decoration / Vf 第52集 - Redfield & Dattner, Wall Decoration
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: Les Cueilleurs S1E3 -The Sea Urchin / Les Cueilleurs 第3集 - The Sea Urchin
programme.desc: Harvesting sea urchins is no easy task. Joseph Roy and Anthony Jean, two professional divers, practise this somewhat unique profession in Cacouna, in the Lower Saint Lawrence.

programme.title: Cuisine Ouverte:2024-2025 E25 -In Isere, With Sidonie Bonnec / Cuisine Ouverte 第25集 - In Isere, With Sidonie Bonnec
programme.desc: Mory Sacko is at the Chateau de Vizille, in Isere, with journalist and novelist Sidonie Bonnec. Today's menu: chicken tagine with prunes and chocolate.

programme.title: Tendance XXI S11E18 -Louvre-L'oreal/Flares/Baton Rouge/Sarouel / Tendance XXI 第18集 - Louvre-L'oreal/Flares/Baton Rouge/Sarouel
programme.desc: In the exhibition 'De toutes beautes!', the Louvre and L'Oreal are helping us to imagine types of beauty that are far removed from the norm. Find out all about the origins of flared trousers. Founder of Baton Rouge, Christelle Percheron offers made-to-measure lipsticks. Wearing a sarouel.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Gout S1E2 -Emma And Marcel's Walk / Les Routes Du Gout 第2集 - Emma And Marcel's Walk
programme.desc: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.

programme.title: Mon Plus Beau Village S6E1 -Luana Fontana In Villers-La-Ville / Mon Plus Beau Village 第1集 - Luana Fontana In Villers-La-Ville
programme.desc: Luana Fontana takes us to Villers-la-Ville, a pleasant hilly village in Walloon Brabant. Among its many attractions, the ruins of a monumental abbey draw the eye. A building shrouded in mystery that is said to have inspired Victor Hugo for 'Les Miserables'.

programme.title: Vroum:2022-2023 E13 -The Seine Estuary / Vroum 第13集 - The Seine Estuary
programme.desc: Laurent explores the Seine estuary with a family where the passion for mechanics is passed down through generations. Michel visits Marina and Rodolphe's workshop, where prestige cars are restored.

programme.title: Les Saisons De Pique-Assiette S15E12 -Mushrooms And Eggs / Les Saisons De Pique-Assiette 第12集 - Mushrooms And Eggs
programme.desc: Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares baked eggs with mushrooms and a spring frittata (Italian egg-based dish), with lots of green, lots of green, lots of green (dandelion, arugula, spinach). Discovery of the day: artisanal mate, a drink that is all the rage.

programme.title: Des Racines & Des Ailes:2020-2025 E4 -Auvergne: Land Of Excellence / Des Racines & Des Ailes 第4集 - Auvergne: Land Of Excellence
programme.desc: Train of legend, the Venice Simplon-Orient-Express, runs from Venice to Paris. After more than a century of service, the inlaid wood interiors have been preserved thanks to the exceptional skills of the craftsmen of Auvergne. A journey through the land of volcanoes, where tradition and expertise are still handed down.

programme.title: C'est Du Belge:2025-2026 E16 -Belgian Passion In Motion / C'est Du Belge 第16集 - Belgian Passion In Motion
programme.desc: Visit to the Cleopatra exhibition at Liege-Guillemins station, before heading towards the peaks of Avoriaz with Gabriel and Helene. Back in Belgium, in Namur, where Alex Hocquet elevates pizza to the rank of gastronomy. And off to Flanders for a festive and crazy cyclo-cross.
